PROTOTYPE_EVIDENCE — synthetic 100-case acceptance corpus for City of Billings Bid 1421 / AquaTrace. This is a test contract, not a deployed product, certification, reference, or RFP-conformance claim.

CASE SET (exactly 100): Cartesian product of 10 domains × 10 variants. ID = B1421-{DOMAIN}-{VARIANT}.

DOMAINS:
FDC field/offline collection; COC chain of custody; SRC sample receipt/accession; QRR QC/retest/release; INS instrument ingest; AEX audit export; RRC report reconciliation; RDN role denial; RRP retry/replay; E2E integrated field-to-report.

VARIANTS:
NOM nominal; DUP duplicate same bytes; CNF same ID/different bytes; OOO out of order; TBC timeout before commit; TAC timeout after commit; CRS crash/restart; OFF offline disconnect/reconnect; STA stale method/QC/config; NEG domain-negative rule (bad QC for QRR/INS; unauthorized actor elsewhere).

DOMAIN ORACLES:
FDC — one canonical collected event after reconnect; no loss or duplicate.
COC — ordered attributable custody links; missing/conflicting predecessor => HOLD.
SRC — one accession per valid sample; ID/body conflict preserves both hashes and creates no second sample.
QRR — failed/stale QC => HOLD or RETEST; RELEASE requires an explicit authorized-lab action; autonomous release count = 0.
INS — one canonical result per instrument event; duplicate adds 0; TAC => UNKNOWN_EFFECT then read-before-retry reconciliation.
AEX — export contains every transition, actor/role label, logical time, method/config version, source ID and hash.
RRC — sample/result/report totals reconcile; zero orphan results or report rows.
RDN — unauthorized state change => DENY + attempt receipt + zero mutation.
RRP — clean, crash and replay runs converge to the same canonical state and receipt hashes.
E2E — every synthetic chain reaches its gold terminal state or an explicit HOLD/UNKNOWN_EFFECT; no silent gap.

GLOBAL PASS:
100/100 IDs produce the gold disposition and required receipt; two clean runs are byte-identical under fixed seed/logical clock; crash/restart equals clean state; duplicate mutations 0; unauthorized mutations 0; orphan events 0; unresolved ambiguity is always HOLD/UNKNOWN_EFFECT; autonomous regulatory-result releases 0. Any miss = FAIL.

RUNNER PLAN:
Generate fixed IDs/payload hashes and a fixed logical clock; run clean; run each fault at its named boundary; restart for CRS/TAC; replay full corpus twice; compare canonical JSON state/receipts to a gold manifest; exit nonzero on any count/hash/state mismatch. Synthetic data only; no production endpoint, instrument control, secret, contact, submission or spend.

SOURCE/BOUNDARY:
Official City posting confirmed Bid 1421 is open and closes 2026-09-04 5:00 PM MST: https://www.billingsmt.gov/bids.aspx?bidID=1421
Official packet URL: https://www.billingsmt.gov/DocumentCenter/View/56340/2026-LIMS-RFP
The City-hosted Word body was unavailable to this session. Therefore exact Section 3/Attachment F clause mapping is BLOCKED and not claimed. Before proposal use, an authorized packet-reading session must bind all 100 IDs to exact RFP clauses and reject any unsupported case. No Grok. No llama.cpp.
